observation: SO119 orders Bate Second Tennessee to Fredericksburg next day and directs return of two First Virginia companies upon arrival.
Ruggles takes about700 with intention to bring remaining500. Both TN regiment and volunteer battalion comprise force; no allocation. Source date May30[?].
Do not turn700+500 into either regiment return, exact district strength, or June15 total.
Four infantry and one cavalry company from vicinity accompany Bate regiment; Bate transferred to Brooke Station. Company strengths unreported.
Walker rifle guns brought into preceding day action; no gun count or personnel count inferred.
Lynch and other naval officers command batteries; Bate commands covering force until Ruggles arrival.
Fagan Arkansas regiment now at Camp Jackson; intended future movement to Chopawamsic is not completion.
Fredericksburg Artillery named; no returned personnel count.
Bate describes one regiment company in battery, remainder in reserve, Walker battery support and mounted detail; later asks about separately promised field battery.
Cluskey names Captain Hunt Carolina Greys garrisoning new battery, part of his regiment.
SO64 IV sends Holmes to assume troops near Fredericksburg; not proof of arrival on same date.
Holmes says he can march at short notice with three volunteer regiments and two batteries after leaving sufficient battery guard. No names or men listed.
Component of H-O12, not plus three-regiment force from another return.
Proposed sufficient guard is not a returned garrison strength.
Lee June15 statement of preparations to transfer date; not June17 manpower return.
Lee retains force; mentions Brockenbrough at Mathias Point. Separate from June18 Holmes opposition to Beauregard detachment.
Deas letter approves organisation Holmes made of Virginia regiment; original organising paper and constituent companies not supplied.
Holmes says about1500 and a battery; not a named-regiment return or a June figure.
Cooper orders three and a light battery; Ruggles left district; SO224 preserves district security and return. No automatic arrival.
Holmes names Second Tennessee, First Arkansas and Walker battery; says Wednesday18July, a weekday/date conflict retained, not silently corrected.
Garnett says Fredericksburg including lower Rappahannock/Potomac counties number not known; an area estimate not sum of June regimental returns.
